value.rationale: The motivating source identifies a cusp of the Berezin range at 1 but leaves its sharp geometry unspecified. Determination of the exact all-symbol horn exponent and leading section coefficient yields an intrinsic inverse invariant that distinguishes Taylor multiplicities and coefficient magnitudes from an unparameterized operator range, stable under all analytic higher-order perturbations. This resolves a natural structural quantification problem, not merely a numerical re-estimate for one monomial.
